changelog:
- Major documentation and methodology upgrade: SKILL.md has been extensively rewritten and expanded.
- Added a layered, step-by-step guide for building digital personas, focusing on extracting dynamic behavioral patterns and internal contradictions, not just static traits.
- Introduced a new "进化阶梯" (evolution ladder) to guide users from basic use to mastery.
- Strengthened the emphasis on the seven-dimension linked model and how to distill each aspect.
- Sharpened quality standards with detailed review checklists and iteration rhythm.
- Added a new example reference file: jobs-soul.md.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
